description: Sanctions screening of a crypto address against the US OFAC SDN list (all its digital-currency addresses: EVM, BTC, TRX, SOL, USDT, USDC…). Use it before an agent pays, receives from or interacts with a wallet. Returns sanctioned true/false, the listed entity and programs, the exact list version used and a signed receipt. Costs 0.005 USD via x402. Screening aid, not legal advice.
name: check_wallet
title: Is this crypto wallet sanctioned? (paid, signed)
